rules: Overlines MUST be Uppercase + tracking-widest (0.2em) + text-xs
Line height: leading-none for headings, leading-relaxed for body
No full-screen gradients. Use subtle mesh gradients or noise textures.
Text on colored backgrounds must meet APCA contrast standards.

textures: Noise Overlay: opacity-5 mix-blend-overlay fixed inset-0 pointer-events-none

marketing_landing.classes: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 p-4 md:p-8

dashboard.classes: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 p-4

buttons.primary: bg-blue-900 text-white rounded-full px-8 py-3 hover:bg-blue-800 transition-all hover:shadow-lg hover:-translate-y-0.5
buttons.secondary: bg-orange-100 text-orange-700 rounded-full px-8 py-3 hover:bg-orange-200 transition-all
buttons.ghost: text-slate-600 hover:text-blue-900 hover:bg-slate-50 rounded-full px-6 py-2

cards.style: bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-100 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-300 group relative overflow-hidden
cards.interactive: Use 'Tracing Beam' effect on hover for product cards.

inputs.style: bg-slate-50 border-transparent focus:border-blue-500 focus:bg-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-100 rounded-lg h-12 px-4 transition-all

hero_family.alt: Happy Indian family representing financial freedom

media.icons: Use Lucide-React. Stroke width: 1.5px (Elegant). Size: 20px or 24px.

principles: Use spring physics (stiffness: 100, damping: 20) for natural feel
Micro-interactions on all buttons (scale: 0.98 on tap)

accessibility.contrast: Ensure 4.5:1 ratio for text. Use Slate-600+ on white.
accessibility.focus: Visible focus rings (ring-2 ring-blue-500 ring-offset-2) are MANDATORY.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Update tailwind.config.js with the new color palette and font families.
3. Refactor the Landing Page to use the Bento Grid layout.
4. Replace generic cards with the 'Tracing Beam' or 'Glass' style cards.
5. Use the provided Image URLs for the specific product sections.
6. Ensure the Dashboard uses the High Density Grid with 'Cardless' widgets where possible.
7. Apply the 'Warm Alabaster' background to the main body to kill the clinical white feel.
8. Use 'Outfit' font for all Headings and 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for body.
9. Add data-testid to all interactive elements.
universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI Slop' - no generic centered layouts.
Use 2-3x more spacing than you think is necessary.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
